label: Finite interpretations for the eight derivations of round 2 on perfection and primacy: for each…
paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the eight derivations of round 2 on perfection and primacy: for each premise, a model in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails, and one joint model with nonempty causing, efficient-causing, reception, limitation, dependence, creature and esse-reception relations in which every premise and conclusion of the batch holds. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
